api.verify.guidance: Show actual case and contract/data/lifecycle verdicts with expected versus observed behavior. Link runner output, command, revision, readback and cleanup; browser screenshots are not an API requirement.

architecture.decide.guidance: Show the chosen boundaries, data ownership and trade-offs as a diagram, decision document or table appropriate to complexity; link observed current state, alternatives and critique resolution.

backend.generate.guidance: Show the reviewable changes diff, affected files and behavior, with conformance and actual proof. Apply names its commit; dry-run clearly labels proposed changes and claims no executed test or mutation.

backend.plan.guidance: Show operation-to-module/store ownership, dependency order and required proof with contract coverage. Planning is not implemented behavior.

business.decide.guidance: Show actor-to-promise rules and observable outcomes, scope coverage and decided exceptions; link claims and the model.

business.reconcile.guidance: Show each promise mapped to delivered behavior and evidence, with any remaining discrepancy. Missing proof cannot support a complete-scope claim.

content.generate.guidance: Render the reviewed article in the display language as the primary result; display relevant generated images with the content and link full articles, review, lab proof and tracks. A thumbnail alone never represents the completed lesson.

data.plan.guidance: Show fixture preconditions, target attribution, namespace, volume, order and rollback. Choose JSON or SQL only as the actual backend requires; never claim rows are already seeded.

data.seed.guidance: Show reused, created, changed or removed records and expected versus readback within the owned namespace. Rollback reports only its exact removed subset; never dump unrelated data.

environment.preflight.guidance: Show every required readiness check with observed state, walls, skipped checks and repair owner. A missing check is not readiness.

git.publish.guidance: Show the non-force published remote/ref/commit, review link when available, hooks and its relation to the tested head. Publishing does not delete the user worktree or branch; session closure retains proof separately.

identity.provision.guidance: Show safe account aliases, roles, reuse/create/repair and sign-in checks. Rotation shows new credentials work and old ones fail, without exposing either credential.

interface.audit.guidance: Display the actual screenshot that best exposes the significant finding, with region, rule and verdict, plus matrix coverage. A completed audit may validly find failures; never choose the prettiest capture to hide them.

interface.fix.guidance: Show the bounded changes diff and the exact finding it addresses, with targeted verification. Label dry-run as proposed changes, and do not claim the later visual audit has passed.

interface.generate.guidance: Embed the actual selected rendered candidate with its focal point and selection reason; link preview, viewport/source binding, score and changes. Dry-run remains a preview, not an applied change; decorative assets cannot replace the rendered surface.

interface.plan.guidance: Show all scoped pages, modals, shared shells and states with routes and implementation units. Expose deferred scope; a surface plan is not a rendered UI.

knowledge.repair.guidance: Show the challenged rule or case before and after, counterexample, exact canonical/mirror owner files, scope and revalidation from the typed receipt. The originating operator retry still owns whether the repair resolves the observed failure.

library.update.guidance: Show mode-specific source changes, package release or consumed dependency movement, with matching proofs. Package publication alone never claims consumer repair; consume names its exact dependency and verification.

migration.release.guidance: Show each pending/applied/already-applied disposition and journal verification, including the second no-op check. A command exit alone is not migration evidence.

quality.verify.guidance: Show measured gates, pass/fail/unrun states, thresholds, blocking findings and owners. A done verifier can validly report failing code; retain source head, commands and scope.

release.deploy.guidance: Show the active target release/digest and observed probe health. Distinguish delivering a new release from rollback restoring the prior one; cover all declared targets.

runtime.serve.guidance: Show the served URL, observed revision, health and reused/updated disposition, with checks and lease. Starting a process alone does not prove the correct application is served.

service.operate.guidance: Show requested versus observed service state and its probe. A requested down state succeeds when the correct service is stopped and the port is free, not when a URL responds.

uat.plan.guidance: Show journey/case actors, entry points, preconditions, expected behavior, account/fixture needs, isolated namespace and reuse/update disposition. Actual results do not exist before the run.

uat.verify.guidance: Show the whole run case summary and the most diagnostic actual evidence. Choose a readable result table, sheet or case screenshot according to the finding, with per-case proof as secondary. Include failed and unrun cases; never use one passing capture to imply the whole journey passed.

workspace.bind.guidance: Show the resolved role, route, checkout, branch, revision and mutation readiness. A source binding does not prove the runtime is serving that revision.
